description: Huawei 4G Mobile WiFi 3 (E5785): no wired Ethernet. Wi-Fi 5, 2.4 GHz 300M, 5 GHz 867M. The 150 Mbps cellular uplink is a radio, not a socket - it resolves to the cellular cage and cannot be cabled. Requested in #153; figures from https://consumer.huawei.com/en/routers/4g-mobile-wifi-3-e5785/specs/
